examples.title: Create action, status and a full-page error
examples.description: A list page’s create action is a secondary icon-only "+" with a tooltip and an accessible name, in the same place in every state. status sits beside the title or under it, a long title wraps to two lines and then ends in an ellipsis with the full title in its tooltip, and error draws the header’s primary buttons as secondary so Try again is the only primary.

examples.title: Large title and decisions that are never hidden
examples.description: A large title that collapses into a sticky bar once it scrolls away. The approval decisions stay visible beside it, and the overflow menu holds only secondary actions; an overflow action marked as a decision is drawn as a button instead.

  headingLevel={2}

  description="Waiting on your approval."
  overflow={[

    <Button>Deny</Button>

examples.title: Hero tones, with and without a focal value
examples.description: A full-bleed hero band in each tone: plain, a tinted indigo wash, a saturated indigo gradient and a near-black night band. It looks finished without media; art adds one faint glyph, and a focal value replaces it.
